en: My older brother is a lawyer.
ipa: /maɪ ˈoʊldər ˈbrʌðər ɪz ə ˈlɔjər/
trPron: May oldır brazır iz ı loyır
commonMistake: My big brother is a lawyer. ✔️
imgQuery: man in suit with law books

en: My younger sister is still in school.
ipa: /maɪ ˈjʌŋgər ˈsɪstər ɪz stɪl ɪn skul/
trPron: May yangır sistır iz stil in skul
commonMistake: My little sister is still in school. ✔️

en: identical twins, twins are
ipa: birth, sibling
trPron: singleton, only
commonMistake: A1

en: My brothers are fraternal twins.
ipa: /maɪ ˈbrʌðərz ɑr frəˈtɜrnəl twɪnz/
trPron: May brazırz ar frıtörnıl tvinz
commonMistake: My brothers are non-identical twins. ✔️

en: My parents' house is near the sea.
ipa: /maɪ ˈpɛrənts haʊs ɪz nɪr ðə si/
trPron: May perınts haus iz nir dı si
commonMistake: My parent's house is near the sea. ❌ (tek ebeveyn)

en: The children's toys are in the living room.
ipa: /ðə ˈʧɪldrənz tɔɪz ɑr ɪn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum/
trPron: Dı çıldrınz toys ar in dı livİng rum
commonMistake: The childrens' toys are in the living room. ❌
aiExplain: Children zaten çoğul, iyelik 's eklenir: children's. NOT childrens'.

en: My immediate family includes my parents and my sister.
tr: Çekirdek ailem annem babam ve kız kardeşimi içerir.
ipa: /maɪ ɪˈmidiət ˈfæməli ɪnˈkludz maɪ ˈpɛrənts ænd maɪ ˈsɪstər/
trPron: May imidiıt family inkludz may perınts end may sistır
commonMistake: My nuclear family includes my parents and my sister. ✔️
aiExplain: Immediate family anne, baba, kardeşler (çekirdek aile).

en: My extended family includes aunts, uncles, and cousins.
tr: Geniş ailem teyzeler, amcalar ve kuzenleri içerir.
ipa: /maɪ ɪkˈstɛndɪd ˈfæməli ɪnˈkludz ænts ˈʌŋkəlz ænd ˈkʌzənz/
trPron: May ikstendıd family inkludz ants ankalz end kazınz
commonMistake: My relatives include aunts, uncles, and cousins. ✔️

en: I have two siblings: one brother and one sister.
tr: İki kardeşim var: bir erkek ve bir kız.
ipa: /aɪ hæv tuː ˈsɪblɪŋz wʌn ˈbrʌðər ænd wʌn ˈsɪstər/
trPron: Ay hev tu siblİngz van brazır end van sistır
commonMistake: I have one brother and one sister. ✔️

en: I have no siblings. I am an only child.
ipa: /aɪ hæv noʊ ˈsɪblɪŋz aɪ æm æn ˈoʊnli tʃaɪld/
trPron: Ay hev no siblİngz ay em en onli çayld
commonMistake: I have no brothers or sisters. ✔️

en: My aunt is raising three children.
ipa: /maɪ ænt ɪz ˈreɪzɪŋ θriː ˈʧɪldrən/
trPron: May ant iz reyzİng tri çıldrın
commonMistake: My aunt is bringing up three children. ✔️

scenario: Take care of parents (anne babaya bakmak)
en: She takes care of her elderly parents.
ipa: /ʃiː teɪks kɛr əv hɜr ˈɛldərli ˈpɛrənts/
trPron: Şi teyks ker ov hır eldırli perınts
collocations: takes care of, care of her
commonMistake: She looks after her elderly parents. ✔️
aiExplain: Take care of birine bakmak / ilgilenmek anlamında.

en: I am very close to my grandmother.
ipa: /aɪ æm ˈvɛri kloʊs tu maɪ ˈgrænmʌðər/
trPron: Ay em veri klous tu may grenmazır
collocations: close to my, close to grandmother
commonMistake: I am very close with my grandmother. ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: Close to someone birine duygusal olarak yakın olmak.

scenario: Look like family member (aile üyesine benzemek)
en: look like, look like my
ipa: resemble, take after
trPron: be different from
commonMistake: A1

en: I take after my mother in many ways.
ipa: /aɪ teɪk ˈæftər maɪ ˈmʌðər ɪn ˈmɛni weɪz/
trPron: Ay teyk aftır may mazır in meni veyz
commonMistake: I resemble my mother in many ways. ✔️
aiExplain: Take after birine karakter olarak benzemek (fiziksel değil).
imgQuery: mother and daughter with similar traits

scenario: Get along with family (aile ile geçinmek)
en: I get along well with my siblings.
ipa: /aɪ gɛt əˈlɔŋ wɛl wɪð maɪ ˈsɪblɪŋz/
trPron: Ay get elong vel wit may siblİngz
collocations: get along with, along with my
commonMistake: I get on well with my siblings. ✔️
aiExplain: Get along with birisiyle iyi geçinmek.

scenario: Plural possessive - sisters' (iki veya daha fazla kız kardeş)
en: My sisters' room is very clean.
ipa: /maɪ ˈsɪstərz rum ɪz ˈvɛri klin/
trPron: May sistırz rum iz veri klin
commonMistake: My sister's room is very clean. ❌ (tek kardeş)
aiExplain: Plural possessive (sisters') - iki veya daha fazla kız kardeş.

en: My eldest brother is thirty years old.
tr: En büyük erkek kardeşim otuz yaşında.
ipa: /maɪ ˈɛldɪst ˈbrʌðər ɪz ˈθɜrti jɪrz oʊld/
trPron: May eldist brazır iz thörti yırs old
commonMistake: My oldest brother is thirty years old. ✔️
aiExplain: Eldest ailedeki en büyük çocuk için kullanılır.

en: I am the youngest in my family.
ipa: /aɪ æm ðə ˈjʌŋgəst ɪn maɪ ˈfæməli/
trPron: Ay em dı yangıst in may family
commonMistake: I am the smallest in my family. ❌ (fiziksel)

en: I am the middle child. I have one older and one younger sister.
tr: Ben ortanca çocuğum. Bir büyük bir de küçük kız kardeşim var.
ipa: /aɪ æm ðə ˈmɪdəl tʃaɪld aɪ hæv wʌn ˈoʊldər ænd wʌn ˈjʌŋgər ˈsɪstər/
trPron: Ay em dı midıl çayld ay hev van oldır end van yangır sistır
commonMistake: I am the middle. ❌ (anlam eksik)
aiExplain: Middle child ne en büyük ne en küçük olan çocuk.

en: My ancestors came from Germany.
ipa: /maɪ ˈænsɛstərz keɪm frʌm ˈʤɜrməni/
trPron: May ansestırz keym fıram Cörmıni
commonMistake: My forefathers came from Germany. ✔️

en: He has no direct descendants.
ipa: /hiː hæz noʊ dəˈskɛndənts/
trPron: Hi hez no dıskendınts
commonMistake: He has no offspring. ✔️

en: Their adopted daughter is very happy.
ipa: /ðɛr əˈdɑptɪd ˈdɔtər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhæpi/
trPron: Der adapdıd dotır iz veri hepi
commonMistake: Their adoptive daughter? (adoptive parents, adopted child)

en: He was raised by foster parents.
ipa: /hiː wʌz reɪzd baɪ ˈfɔstər ˈpɛrənts/
trPron: Hi vaz reyzd bay fostır perınts
commonMistake: He was raised by a foster family. ✔️

en: In a blended family, children may have step-siblings.
tr: Karma ailede, çocukların üvey kardeşleri olabilir.
ipa: /ɪn ə ˈblɛndɪd ˈfæməli ˈʧɪldrən meɪ hæv stɛp ˈsɪblɪŋz/
trPron: İn ı blendıd family çıldrın mey hev step siblİngz
commonMistake: In a stepfamily, children may have step-siblings. ✔️
aiExplain: Blended family üvey kardeşleri olan karma aile.
